differences: Experiment 1, Miss group: the paper prints an asymptote of 18.88 deg; the rows and the authors' own Fig 1C file give 18.8676 (the SD, 9.33, matches).
Experiment 3 has 801 clamp trials per participant in the file; the paper says 800.
Experiment 3, No Jump vs Jump-In-Place: t(17) = 1.9651 from the rows (with the authors' exclusions, whose condition means match their Fig 3 files exactly); the paper prints 1.96.
Experiments 3 and 4: the authors' 3 SD / 90 deg rule removes 1.2% and 1.3% of clamp trials as their scripts compute it; the paper says under 1% of trials.
